title: MySQL: Defragment decompressed PDUs inside compressed PDUs
description:
The Compressed Payload of a MySQL compressed packet "can be anything
from a piece of a MySQL Packet to several MySQL Packets."

https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_basic_compression_packet.html

That means that there are two layers of fragmentation possible -
segmentation of the compressed PDUs at the TCP layer, and a further
fragmentation of the decompressed PDUs at the MySQL layer, similar
to fragmentation of TLS records.

Implement a dissector that sets pinfo->desegment_len and
pinfo->desegment_offset, and use the new helper function for
reassembling such fragmented bitstreams on top of TCP.

Fix #19050
